title: (De-)Exciting the Third Poschl-Teller Kink
summary: There is a series of scalar models possessing reflectionless kinks whose linear perturbations are described by a Pöschl-Teller potential at integer level $σ$. The cases $σ=1$ and $2$ are the well-known Sine-Gordon and $φ^4$ double-well models. The $σ=3$ kink has received relatively little attention because it exhibits a $φ^{8/3}$ potential, whose third derivative diverges in the vacuum. In old-fashioned perturbation theory this yields a cubic interaction that diverges far from a kink.
